response.content: {"visual":{"fullPrompt":"Bright social-first editorial lifestyle photograph, 16:9, of SCARLETT DOYLE wearing her pale kiosk uniform polo with the collar loose and the hem half-tucked into denim cutoff shorts, bare legs, rubber thongs, an elastic hair tie around her wrist and a ring of kiosk keys hooked on her belt loop, coral lipstick on her mouth. She is caught in the starting frame mid-breath, one hand braced on the sun-bleached timber counter ledge of a small beachfront kiosk, shoulders squared and weight shifting onto her front foot as if about to push off and run, chin turning to glance sharply off-camera to the right, jaw set, a faint amused half-smile just forming — pure potential energy, nothing yet in motion. The kiosk interior is cramped and real: a chest freezer lid propped open breathing cold vapour, skewers of frozen pineapple in a plastic tub beading with meltwater, a stack of paper napkins weighted by a smooth beach stone, coiled hose, chipped mint-green paint on the serving hatch frame, a physical wall clock with tactile hands above her shoulder, taped handwritten-free cardboard scraps and a scatter of dried sand across the concrete floor. Through the open hatch behind her, blown-out morning ocean light: a bright wedge of Bondi sand, blurred surf breaking in soft bokeh, distant swimmers and a headland reduced to pale haze. Hard clean directional sunlight rakes in through the hatch, throwing a crisp geometric shadow band across her forearm and the counter, whites crisp and slightly warm in the highlights, shadows lifted and airy, one coral accent popping against the neutral timber and white base. Shot handheld with subtle micro-shake on a 35mm lens at eye level, shallow depth of field holding her face and the counter edge sharp while the beach dissolves behind, natural film grain, true-to-life clean color grade, high-key and immediate.","negativePrompt":"holograms, floating interfaces, HUD, glowing UI, text, subtitles, captions, signage, logos with readable words, watermarks, heavy diffusion, hazy fog filter, teal-orange grade, moody low-key lighting, cluttered composition, motion blur streaks, extra limbs, deformed hands, duplicate faces, cartoon, illustration, plastic skin, oversaturated, night, studio seamless backdrop, multiple panels, collage"}}
